segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so based on the 38 seats you outlined, the annual plan would be $41,952 for the year, and then a one-time onboarding package at $2,400. That includes the two admin trainings and the data import help.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the 38, that's 31 managers plus the seven regional admins. If we add field supervisors later, are we locked into a different rate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, you can add seats mid-term at the same $92 per user per month rate, prorated through the March 31 end date. If you crossed 50 seats, the pricing sheet moves you to $86 for any new quote.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. For go-live, we were targeting September 16. Is that realistic if we sign this week?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If the order is signed by Friday, kickoff would be August 26, configuration the week after, and user training on September 10 and 12. September 16 is a normal timeline.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal had one question on the contract term. It's a 12-month initial term, no auto-renew, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. It runs April 1 through March 31, and it does not auto-renew. We would send renewal pricing ahead of the end date and you decide from there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Billing wants the invoice split, software to cost center 410 and onboarding to 425. Can you do that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. The invoice will show two lines, software at $41,952 to 410 and onboarding at $2,400 to 425, net 30. If you need a PO number on it, just send that over with the signed order.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We will. I think we're good. Send the order form to me and Dana, and I'll route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it over in the next half hour with the dates and seat count exactly as we discussed.
